tools.name: get_place_overview
tools.title: Get place overview
tools.description: Return the published overview for this GoVisit place, including its published classifications with scheme, recipient, validity and available evidence, and its operating status: operatingStatus.code is operational, temporarily_closed or permanently_closed, and null when the status is unknown. Operating status says whether the place still operates, not whether it is open right now. The result excludes place spatial details, which are available from the Location section, and includes freshness metadata from the page snapshot. Owner, chain and operator are organization names, each null when unknown; operator identifies the company managing the facility, distinct from profile management.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.title: Get statistics
tools.description: Return exact governed catalog coverage counts and per-metric observation metadata from this cached public page. Scope is physical World on landing pages, or the parent Destination on Destination, category and collection pages. A measured zero is zero; missing or invalid metrics are unknown. Coverage is recalculated daily and may be slightly inaccurate within the day. Counts are not live availability, bounded search/list totals, or rounded homepage headlines.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.title: Search destinations
tools.description: Search published destinations by name or traveler intent. mode defaults to auto: exact name matches avoid embedding; otherwise name and intent results are combined. Explicit name never embeds; intent always searches by meaning. Returns stable destination codes, public URLs, match method, scope and index release. Optional within and types filter canonical geography before ranking; they require a geography-enabled release. Whole-Division containment takes precedence over a default hierarchy parent for cross-border destinations; unknown scope is never assumed. Types are published classifications, not population or city tiers.

query.description: Place or destination name, or the traveler's intent.

mode.description: Name lookup, intent retrieval, or name-first auto discovery.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

language.description: Requested response language; defaults to the page language.

within.description: Canonical destination code to explore within; all is reserved for an explicit unrestricted place search, never a containing-destination filter.

types.description: Match any of these published classifications; not a size/tier filter.

tools.name: search_places
tools.title: Search places
tools.description: For faster searches, pass a known country or destination code. Unscoped name lookups search all covered countries. Search published places by name or traveler intent. mode defaults to auto: exact names avoid embedding, otherwise combine name and intent candidates without duplicate IDs. Explicit name never embeds. A destination page supplies its scope; country, destination and near intersect and never widen. Scoped names and proximity require a geography-enabled index release; older releases report unavailable constraints. At most 200 candidate records are examined before returning up to 20 items, with counts/truncation; a missing result is not proof of invisibility everywhere. Distance is geographic meters, not walking time. Scores and profile quality are retrieval signals, not proof of amenities or suitability. Intent uses one query embedding.

query.description: Place or destination name, or the traveler's intent.

mode.description: Name lookup, intent retrieval, or name-first auto discovery.

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return. Defaults to 10. Name mode allows up to 10. Other modes allow up to 20.

language.description: Requested response language; defaults to the page language.

destination.description: Stable destination code or all. Defaults to the current destination, otherwise all.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code. Supply it when the country is known to narrow the search. Intersects destination and proximity where the public geography projection is available.

placeId.description: Reference GERS Place resolved from the same public release.

coordinates.description: Reference point in latitude and longitude.

radiusMeters.description: Maximum straight-line distance from the reference point, in meters.

near.description: Proximity filter with a radius in meters. Supply either a GoVisit place ID or explicit coordinates as the reference.
